import 'package:hazard_fixture/tables.dart';
import 'package:hazard_fixture/tables_user.dart';
import 'package:test/test.dart';

void main() {
  test('limit', () {
    expect(limit(0), 1);
    expect(limit(1), 2);
    expect(limit(2), 3);
  });

  test('identity of a constant', () {
    expect(sameAsLiteral(), isTrue);
    expect(sameConstants(), isTrue);
  });

  test('a constant cannot be changed', () {
    expect(change, throwsUnsupportedError);
    expect(grow, throwsUnsupportedError);
    expect(look('x'), 1);
    expect(look('y'), 2);
    expect(known(1), isTrue);
    expect(known(9), isFalse);
  });

  test('constants in constant places', () {
    expect(sum(), 30);
    expect(sum(values: [1]), 1);
    expect(kind(2), 'two');
    expect(kind(7), 'span');
    expect(kind(0), 'other');
    expect(boxed(), 12);
    expect(nested(), 20);
  });

  test('a public constant in another library and here', () {
    const here = [publicLimit, 1];
    expect(here.first, 7);
    expect(named(publicLimit), 'limit');
    expect(named(1), 'no 2');
    expect(usersLimits, [7, 8]);
  });

  test('a constant used at runtime only', () {
    expect(Grid.total(), 20);
    expect(localSum(), 12);
  });
}
